messages:
Mira: Quick heads up — canary results for the new 'strided-batcher' are in. Big wins on mixed-length chat workloads.
Dan: numbers?
Mira: p50 down ~18%, p95 down ~12%, p99 down ~9% on long-context (8k token) tail. Cost-per-token down ~22% for long-context workloads. Short requests mostly neutral.
Elaine: awesome. Any regressions observed?
Mira: error rates unchanged (0.02% before -> 0.02% now). Memory uptick ~+3% on GPU, still within node headroom.
Tom: how did we test — is this A/B or full canary? dataset?
Mira: 10% live traffic canary for 72h + replayed synthetic spikes. Mixed chat corpus + long-context synthetic to stress the stride behavior. Dashboard: https://console.redwood/s/strided-batcher/canary/1902345678
Build-bot: Canary deploy finished — canary_id=cb-1902345678, image=runtime:3.12.0-stride, sha=abcd1234
Zoe: rollout plan?
Mira: promote to 25% tomorrow if error budget OK, 50% next week, full rollout in ~2 weeks. Auto-fallback to legacy batcher if p99 exceeds 20% over baseline.
Dan: any config knobs teams should know about?
Mira: defaults: stride=8, max_batch=256, seq_threshold=4096. Per-route override available. Example route snippet: 
```
batcher:
  type: strided
  stride: 8
  max_batch: 256
  seq_threshold: 4096
```
Tom: caveats? edge-cases?
Mira: best for high-variance length traffic. Slight regressions for ultra-short requests (<32 tokens) so we route short-only routes to legacy batcher by default. Also watch GPU memory for models with large kv cache.
Elaine: I'll add an eng-runtime README note and create an alert: `stride-batcher-p99 > 280ms` to page oncall.
Mira: added rollout checklist + runbook (internal): /docs/runbooks/stride-batcher.md
Ryan: embedding endpoints impacted?
Mira: embeddings disabled for this batcher by default — no perf change expected.
Sre-bot: @oncall deploy-watch: no sev alerts in last 72h for cb-1902345678 (metrics stable)
Mira: thanks everyone :tada: — will follow up with kernel-level changes and microbench artifact sizes once the bench cluster finishes the final runs.
Elaine: post the bench artifacts in #eng-runtime once available, will update release notes.
Mira: will do.
Dan: nice work — big win for cost on long sessions.
Mira: team effort — shoutout @Tom for scheduler hooks and @Zoe for the routing policy tests. :clap:
Build-bot: Canary metrics summary attached: throughput +9%, token-cost -22% (long-tail), p99 -9% (long-context) — artifact: s3://redwood-bench/stride-1902345678/report.html
Mira: link shared in the thread, arch/qa please review before wider rollout.
